summary.text: Jamie Scott represents District 12 in the Arkansas Senate, which includes parts of Pulaski County; she was elected in November 2024 and took the oath of office on the first day of the 2025 session.

paragraphs.text: Scott holds a Bachelor of Arts in criminology and sociology and a Master of Arts in criminal justice from Arkansas State University, and works as executive director of Youth Services.
Before the Senate, Scott served in the Arkansas House of Representatives; the legislature's member page, which lists the same occupation, shows House terms beginning in 2019.
